 entertainment Super Junior's Yesung, Lucy: Singapore concert calendar for 2026
 Korean stars Yesung (left) and Lucy will be performing in Singapore. PHOTO: Instagram/Yesung SM Town, Instagram/Lucy PUBLISHED ON October 27, 2026 5:59 AM UPDATED October 27, 2026 5:59 AM The first half of 2026 was exciting and packed full of concerts. How's the second half looking for you? 
 This article was first published on Dec 11, 2025. 
 November
 American singer-songwriter Benson Boone will perform at The Star Theatre on Nov 2. Tickets start at $128. Artiste presales begin July 20, Lushington presales on July 21 and general sales the following day on Ticketmaster . 
 Canadian singer Yung Kai takes the stage at Capitol Theatre on Nov 3. Tickets start at $98 on Ticketmaster .
 On Nov 4, American pop-rock band Lany perform at Singapore Indoor Stadium for their Soft world tour. Tickets start at $138 on Ticketmaster .
 K-pop girl group Izna will perform at Capitol Theatre on Nov 8. Tickets start at $160 on Bookmyshow .
 Also here on Nov 8 is Hong Kong singer William So . He'll be at Esplanade Theatre with tickets starting at $88 on Bookmyshow .
 [Postponed] American rock band My Chemical Romance will now take the stage at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on Nov 10 and 11, instead of April 28 . Tickets are sold out.
 On Nov 13, Japanese singer Takase Toya will be at Esplanade Annexe Studio. Tickets start at $78 on Bookmyshow .
 Chinese singer YoungCaptain brings his I Am What I Am concert to Resorts World Convention Centre on Nov 14. Tickets go on sale on Aug 18, priced from $98 on Bookmyshow .
 South Korean band Lucy perform their debut Singapore concert on Nov 14 at Capitol Theatre. Tickets start at $138 on Ticketmaster . 
 Singaporean singer Regina Song will be playing her first-ever headline performance Everland: The Launch Show on Nov 15 at Capitol Theatre. Tickets start at $98 and will go on sale on Sistic and the SG Culture Pass website on Aug 18.
         View this post on Instagram                       A post shared by Regina Song (@sleepyreggy) 
 Australian pop band 5 Seconds of Summer , also known as 5sos, are returning to Singapore, taking the stage at The Star Theatre for their Everyone’s A Star world tour on Nov 16 and Dec 3. Tickets for the first show are sold out while tickets to the second show are available on Ticketmaster from $148 . 
 South Korean indie rock band Wave to Earth will perform at the Indoor Stadium on Nov 20. Tickets start at $148 on Ticketmaster . 
 Japanese singer-songwriter Joji will perform here on Nov 21 and 22. Tickets begin at $128 on Ticketmaster .
 Canadian rock band Simple Plan will be at the Indoor Stadium on Nov 22. Tickets start at $98 on Sistic .
 American singer-songwriter Khalid is bringing his It's Always Summer Somewhere Tour to The Star Theatre on Nov 24. General sales start on July 16 on Ticketmaster . A meet-and-greet experience, inclusive of a seated ticket, photo opportunity and signed goods, is available. 
 Canadian jazz singer Diana Krall will perform at Esplanade Concert Hall on Nov 24 and 25. Tickets start at $88 on Sistic .
 American rock band Guns N' Roses will take over National Stadium on Nov 25. Tickets begin at $138 on Ticketmaster .
 [embed]https://www.instagram.com/p/DVhuu8gjEnN/[/embed]
 K-pop girl group Le Sserafim will take their Pureflow world tour to Singapore on Nov 28. Tickets start at $198 on Ticketmaster . 
 Also performing on Nov 28 and 29 is K-pop girl group Babymonster at Singapore Indoor Stadium. Tickets for the first night are sold out; those for the second night start at $168 on Ticketmaster .
 Japanese R&B singer-songwriter Mahiru performs live in Singapore for the first time on Nov 29 at Victoria Theatre, with local actor-singer Glenn Yong as special guest. Tickets start from $118 at Ticketmaster .
 French singer FKJ performs at Arena @ Expo on Nov 29. Tickets start at $108 and are available on Ticketmaster . 
 On Nov 30, American singer-songwriter Malcolm Todd performs at The Star Theatre. Tickets start at $88 on Ticketmaster .
 December
 Irish rock band Two Door Cinema Club will be performing their greatest hits at Fort Canning Green @ Fort Canning Park on Dec 4 for their 15th anniversary tour. Tickets start at $168 on Sistic . 
 Super Junior's Yesung will be at The Theatre at Mediacorp on Dec 5 for his 10th anniversary concert About The Things We Called Ordinary. Tickets start at $168 on Ticketmaster .
 Jan, JingJing, Kapook and Ciize from Thai girls' love drama Enemies with Benefits will hold a fan-meet at D'Marquee @ Downtown East on Dec 5. Tickets start at $198 on Ticketmelon . 
 On Dec 10, New Zealand band Six60 perform at *Scape Ground Theatre for their debut Singapore show. Tickets start at $108 on Ticketmaster .
 Also performing on Dec 10 is English rock band Wolf Alice and they will be at Fort Canning Park. Tickets start at $158 on Sistic .
 English rock band Slowdive will be at Fort Green @ Fort Canning Park on Dec 12 for their concert. Presales for LAMC members start on July 16 with general sales the next day. Tickets are priced at $158 on LAMC's website .  
 Singapore R&B trio Brb. perform at *Scape Ground Theatre on Dec 13. Tickets start at $98 on Ticketmaster .
 K-pop supergroup BTS will be coming to Singapore with their long-awaited BTS World Tour, performing on Dec 17, 19, 20 and 22, the longest run in Asia outside of South Korea and Japan. This is the first time in seven years that they are returning here as a group. Tickets are sold out.

 K-pop group Super Junior will hold their 20th anniversary tour Super Show 10 in Singapore on Jan 2 and 3 at the Singapore Indoor Stadium. Tickets, priced from $228, are still available for Jan 2 on Ticketmaster.
 Kenny Bee performs at MBS Sands Ballroom on the same day. Tickets start at $108 on Sistic. 
 Korean boy band Verivery will hold their fanmeet at The Theatre at Mediacorp on Jan 3. Tickets start at $118 on Ticketmaster.

 K-pop boy band Tomorrow X Together , also known as TXT , bring their tour to Singapore Indoor Stadium Jan 17 and 18. Tickets start at $168 on Ticketmaster.
